stories.title: Jamia opens second phase of boys' hostel admissions; online applications close Monday 16 November
stories.body: Jamia Millia Islamia has begun the second phase of hostel admissions for its boys' hostels for the 2026-27 session, according to an Amar Ujala report published on Friday 6 November. Students enrolled in regular Jamia courses can apply online on the university portal, mj.jmi.ac.in, until 5 pm on Monday 16 November. After applying, they must submit a printed copy of the form with the required documents, including the course admission fee receipt, to the Provost's office by 4.30 pm on Wednesday 18 November. The report does not say how many seats are available or give eligibility rules beyond enrolment in a regular course.
stories.check: Single source, a Hindi video page from Amar Ujala; the video itself was not viewable as text. No matching Jamia notice or press release could be opened in this run. Confirm the portal address and both deadlines with the Provost's office or the Jamia website.
